test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a flagship programme of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Desert Development Programme**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The** desert development programme** started in 1977-1978.
 
• The programme was initiated by the** central government under the recommendations of the National Commission on Agriculture.**
 
• **The objective of the programme​**
 
 
• To minimise the effects of adverse climatic conditions.
 
• To restore ecological balance through natural resources.
 
• To control >desertification
 
• The programme also aims to
 
• Achieve ecological balance
 
• To promote overall economic development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin**

 
 
• To achieve the objective of providing “Housing to All” by the year 2022, the Government of India rolled out the revamped rural housing scheme,
 
• Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G) was launched on 20th November, 2016 with effect from 1 April 2016. 
 
• Ministry of Rural Development along with States and UTs have undertaken various activities like Bhoomi Pujan, Gruh Pravesh, visit of beneficiaries to demonstration houses, and sensitization of beneficiaries about PMAY-G to celebrate Awaas Diwas.
 
 
 
• **National Rural Health Mission**
 
 
• The National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) was launched on April 12, 2005.
 
• It is a major program launched by the Government of India to improve health services in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan**
 
 
• It is a flagship programme of the government of India, that was started in 2001, to achieve the Universalisation of Elementary Education (UEE).
 
• It was started by the Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
 
• The legal backing to SSA was provided when free and compulsory education for children in the age group of 6-14 was made a fundamental right in the Indian Constitution under Article 21 A.
 
• SSA aims to meet the expectations of this fundamental right in a time-bound manner.
 
• Ministry of Human Resource Development (Now Ministry of Education), Government of India (GoI) anchors the SSA Programme and it has been operational since 2000-2001. 
 
• SSA is termed as an ‘Education for All’ movement
